title: Federal Income Tax Payments by Income Percentile
notes: Note: There were roughly 153.8 million total federal income tax filers in 2022. Total adjusted gross income (AGI) was roughly $14.75 trillion. The top 1% of earners have AGI above $663,164; the top 5% have AGI above $261,591; the top 10% have AGI above $178,611; the top 25% have AGI above $99,857; and the top 50% have AGI above $50,339.
source: Source: Tax Foundation, "Summary of the Latest Federal Income Tax Data, 2025 Update"; IRS, Statistics of Income Division.
